items.title: HII Q3 deep dive: margin expansion and contract wins drive upbeat outlook
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company Huntington Ingalls (NYSE:HII) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 10.8% year on year to $3.54 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.48 per share was 23.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII) Marks Record Q3 Revenue With ROMULUS Milestones
items.summary: Huntington Ingalls Industries (NYSE:HII) reported record Q3 revenues, highlighting its largest quarterly top line to date. The company reached key U.S. Navy milestones on ROMULUS unmanned surface vessel production, underscoring progress in autonomous maritime systems. Management linked the quarter's performance to expanding work on Navy contracts tied to advanced naval and robotics capabilities.
